excerpts: The Tigers marched 75 yards in eight plays, culminating with a seven-yard touchdown pass from Austin Simmons to Donovan Olugbode. Oliver Robbins added the point after and Missouri led 7-3 with 4:10 remaining in the first quarter.
Missouri covered 94 yards in eight plays, ending with a 23-yard touchdown pass from Simmons to Jude James. Robbins added the PAT and Missouri led 14-3 with 8:28 to play in the half.

Missouri took little time to get on the board again. The Tigers marched 72 yards in just four plays, ending with a 41-yard touchdown pass from Simmons to Naeshaun Montgomery. Robbins added the point after and Missouri led 21-3.

Missouri had a response. The Tigers covered 75 yards in six play drive, ending with a 60-yard pass from Simmons to Olugbode for a touchdown. Robbins made another PAT and the Tigers led 28-6 with 4:30 to play in the third quarter.

The Cats would get in the end zone early in the fourth quarter. UK covered 81 yards in 14 plays, ending with a two-yard touchdown run by Barnes. The Cats went for two, and Minchey found Barnes for a completion and a successful try. The Cats still trailed 28-14 with 13:23 to play.
